text_block_list.text:
While helping T.M. Opera O rehearse for 
her "New Year's Family Performance" back 
at her hometown over the holidays...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
La la la~♪ ...Oh? Who is that over 
there...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ayabe-san. Oh dear, were you drawn 
here by my singing voice?! Would you like 
to watch too? The rehearsal for my New 
Year's hometown performance!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...? I'm not gonna look.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, she's just holding back. There's no 
way she doesn't want to see it. After all, 
it's a rare home performance usually 
reserved for family—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahahaaaaa! What magnificent 
weather! An open-air performance this 
year! This entire world is my stageeeee!

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
*clap clap clap*~! I've been waiting for 
this~! Oh, the props I made are right 
there!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your taste is magnificent this year 
as well! That rose... I can hardly believe 
it's made of origami!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, it's almost showtime, but...

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, so sorry~! I'm late! My shift got 
extended...! Who knew the supermarket 
would be so packed on New Year's Day...!

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Father
text_block_list.text:
Man, traffic was pretty bad out there. 
Good thing I came to pick you up by car. 
Look, I bought some osechi and amazake 
too~

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother... it seems you made it 
just in time! Then let the show begin! 
"New Year's Special Family Performance: 
Dawn of the Overlord!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—La~ lalalala~♪ Out with the old Overlord~ 
in with the new Overlord~~♪ A brand-new 
year is here~♪

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, and so it begins! Seeing this 
every year always makes me think, 
"Alright, I'm gonna give work my all this 
year too!"...

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Our family's year always has to 
start with Big Sis's New Year performance! 
Right~♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ... ......How peaceful.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Exactly!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Warm, deeply affectionate, overflowing 
with consideration... and endowed with a 
profound understanding and appreciation of 
art...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aren't they a wonderful family...? Their 
love nurtured the Supreme Ruler, and 
thanks to that, the world has been 
illuminated...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Performances in my hometown... are held to 
show my deep love and gratitude to all of 
them.
choice_data_list: You really love your family, huh.
You really love your family, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Looks like it...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm? Speak of the devil!

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"—Hellooo, big sis? It's meee! How are 
your preparations for coming home going? 
You'll still make it back on schedule, 
right?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O my beloved sister! There are no problems 
whatsoever. More importantly, you called 
at just the right time! I was just 
chatting with our companions!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold... this is my Trainer. Come! 
Exchange greetings!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And this cool Umamusume is Admire Vega! 
Fufu, she and I are exceptionally close 
friends, you know!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wait... on your own...!?

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Yay, my big sister's friend~! Thanks for 
always taking care of her!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh... Um... yeah...

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe, I don't want to hold you up, so 
I'll hang up now. I'm really looking 
forward to the hometown show again this 
year~!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun...! Did you hear that!? 
Ayabe-san just said "yes"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I am profoundly moved...! For 
you, who are always so shy, to nod so 
readily...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because after hearing that—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Forget it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I hope your little sister enjoys the 
show.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san...! Still a shy girl at heart, I 
see. Nevertheless, I have received your 
encouragement!
